_comment: Hand assessments merged into freebsd/PATCH-MATRIX.md by freebsd/tools/patch-matrix. Keys are Chromium paths. Keep entries for rows with behavioural risk; the tool fills the rest from a heuristic.

chrome/common/chrome_paths.h.semantic_risk: behavioural: BSD enables Linux path constants; Helium adds native-messaging host scanning of Chrome's directories
chrome/common/chrome_paths.h.resolution: both apply; Beryllium platform patch must point BSD's hard-coded /usr/local/share/chromium paths at /usr/local/share/beryllium
chrome/common/chrome_paths.h.test: functional: native messaging host and external extension directories resolve under the beryllium paths

chrome/common/chrome_paths.cc.semantic_risk: behavioural: BSD hard-codes /usr/local/share/chromium/extensions; Helium scans Chrome native-messaging directories
chrome/common/chrome_paths.cc.resolution: Beryllium platform patch renames the BSD paths; review which foreign browser directories Helium's scan reaches on FreeBSD

chrome/app/chrome_main_delegate.cc.semantic_risk: behavioural: BSD keeps Crashpad from starting; Helium adds version reporting nearby
chrome/app/chrome_main_delegate.cc.resolution: both apply; no crash handler process on FreeBSD (07 section 4 item 1)
chrome/app/chrome_main_delegate.cc.test: privacy: no crash handler process and no crash upload in the capture run; chrome://version shows the Beryllium version

net/base/features.cc.semantic_risk: behavioural: BSD enables Linux/Windows feature defaults; Helium splits the TLS ClientHello and ungoogled adds an IPv6 probing option
net/base/features.cc.test: privacy: TLS fingerprint of a capture matches Helium on Linux for the same Chromium version

components/embedder_support/user_agent_u.semantic_risk: behavioural, privacy (RT-13): BSD reports Linux platform strings; Helium spoofs the Chrome brand; ungoogled reduces system info
components/embedder_support/user_agent_u.resolution: both apply; Beryllium adds the uname fallback fix (RT-13)
components/embedder_support/user_agent_u.test: privacy: fingerprint page shows Linux x86_64 everywhere (07 section 4a)

third_party/blink/renderer/core/executio.semantic_risk: behavioural, privacy (RT-13): BSD returns Linux x86_64 for the reduced platform; Helium's noise changes hardwareConcurrency
third_party/blink/renderer/core/executio.test: privacy: fingerprint page in window and worker contexts

content/public/common/url_constants.h.semantic_risk: behavioural, security-review: display scheme value (beryllium://) set on top of Helium's override-chrome-protocol
content/public/common/url_constants.h.resolution: Beryllium patch depends on Helium's; expected overlap
content/public/common/url_constants.h.test: functional: beryllium://settings loads, web pages cannot navigate to beryllium:// (patches/branding/beryllium-webui-scheme.patch)

components/url_formatter/url_fixer.cc.semantic_risk: behavioural: second copy of the display scheme constant
components/url_formatter/url_fixer.cc.resolution: Beryllium patch depends on Helium's; expected overlap
components/url_formatter/url_fixer.cc.test: functional: typing beryllium://settings in the omnibox fixes up correctly

components/omnibox/browser/builtin_provi.semantic_risk: UI: builtin suggestions show the display scheme
components/omnibox/browser/builtin_provi.resolution: Beryllium patch depends on Helium's; expected overlap

chrome/browser/resources/tab_search/tab_.semantic_risk: UI: tab search shows the display scheme
chrome/browser/resources/tab_search/tab_.resolution: Beryllium patch depends on Helium's; expected overlap
chrome/browser/resources/tab_search/tab_.test: functional: tab search shows beryllium:// for internal pages
